title: Updated Nationally Determined Contribution of the Kyrgyz Republic
organization: State Committee for Ecology and Climate of the Kyrgyz Republic
temporal_coverage: Updated NDC published in 2021, with commitments and measures through 2030.
methodology: Prepared through an inter-agency process with experts, scientists, civil society, the private sector, and youth.
limitations: National policy assessment; proposed adaptation measures are not evaluated outcomes.

title: Kyrgyz Republic Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: World Bank CCDR summary page presenting current risks and projections through mid-century.
methodology: Official World Bank summary of the 2025 CCDR risk, economic-impact, and policy findings.
limitations: The complete report PDF exceeded the browser size limit; the official summary does not specify all model scenarios.

title: World Bank Supports the Kyrgyz Republic in Sustainable Landscape Management and Climate Mitigation and Adaptation
temporal_coverage: Press release dated February 2024; project implementation planned through 2029.
methodology: Official World Bank release describing an approved resilient-landscape project and intended coverage and activities.
limitations: Beneficiary figures and activities are project plans, not completed results.
